reasons: The cited clause (p0171) selects New York substantive law but contains no forum/venue provision, and the rationale notes no arbitration or venue language elsewhere; the preferred position requires both accepted law and exclusive New York County courts, so treating the missing forum element as a deviation is defensible and actionable.

The redline is directionally correct and minimal: it leaves the existing choice-of-law sentence untouched and appends a single sentence conferring exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, exactly matching the preferred position and the redline guidance to change only jurisdiction/forum wording.

Deterministic checks confirm the governing law is within the accepted set and the edit is minimal; the 0.574 changed-character ratio is an artifact of appending one sentence to a short paragraph, not an over-broad rewrite.

The comment is accurate, concise, in first-person plural with the required [Playbook] prefix, correctly states that New York law already matches our position and explains that only exclusive venue was added and why.
